Real bot CLI auth status, strict-mode bot and bot-info probes are read-only. User/unready identities never fall back. PATH selection excludes worker shims and relative entries that actually contain executable files, retaining the selected alias.

Every Lark RPC adds --as bot --format json with no shell interpolation. Setup probes have 60-second deadlines, normal commands 90 seconds, capture is bounded, and readiness is 45 seconds. Real child/descendant trees are cancelled/joined on cancellation and timeout.

Member synchronization preserves existing member order, updates names in place, removes missing members and appends new ones; exact identity-relevant JsValue output ordering is compared. has_more/truncations/missing required data fail instead of producing an empty allowed list. Persistence/revision/health integration remains undone.

Threaded replies use the receipt ID as the idempotency key and enforce the 100-word business limit. Only coded definitive gone cases become Gone; transient, uncoded-withdrawn and membership errors remain errors. Explicit ok:true with no payload still succeeds for no-data reply operations, as the original does; readers validate their own required payload.

The managed event reader retains split UTF-8 Chinese/emoji, reports malformed lines without inventing messages, handles warning/ready lines and drains unterminated EOF lines. Natural exit is an error, not a falsely ready Source. Consumer restart delay calculation is bounded 1-60 seconds; application watch/retry/health is not claimed wired.
